ceiling_risk_proxy.name: high unchanged-DEV accuracy (ceiling-risk proxy)
ceiling_risk_proxy.source: derived: strict-correct C count of the frozen unchanged-model DEV baseline results ZIP (SHA-256 a8194ac29cb17711d8e8e526835daacc368fdc4b5265f51d41f96edff347171a, run phase2_dev-b0d6a0eab0de48edbd251d5703c81ec8, 120 resolved generations)
ceiling_risk_proxy.note: A proxy from the unchanged model on DEV; it does not establish a ceiling for the trained comparator. Δ_C stays first in the report and S2 stays descriptive.

bootstrap.generator: fresh random.Random(101); 10000 rows x 100 draws of rng.randrange(100), row-major
bootstrap.matrix_hash_encoding: UTF-8 text, one line per row, indices joined by ',', newline after every row
bootstrap.interval: 95% percentile, linear quantile h = (R - 1) p at p = .025/.975
bootstrap.hoeffding: (b - a) sqrt(log(40)/(2N)) intersected with [a, b]: [-1, 1] for differences, [-2, 2] for S3
bootstrap.note: Approximate interval conditional on the trained checkpoints; does not cover training-seed variance. The 100-family mean is a finite-set descriptive quantity; intervals describe hypothetical independent families from this fixed authoring and review process (template and author dependence is a limitation). Δ_C is the effect of the complete training-rendering recipe, not an isolated effect of code-switching (Amendment 1 item 3).
